mcq: Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the ability to act within the values and ethics of the community; values which are established for the sake of equity and fairness in the society."
Personhood is the ability to act within the values and ethics of the community; values which are established for the sake of equity and fairness in the society.

Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a suspicious phenomenon in African traditional belief system, making it the possible culprit for any kind of mishap or misfortune in the life of the individual."
Witchcraft is a suspicious phenomenon in African traditional belief system, making it the possible culprit for any kind of mishap or misfortune in the life of the individual.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a patterned way of life shared by a particular group of people that claim a common origin or decent (Idang, 2015, p 98)."
Culture is a patterned way of life shared by a particular group of people that claim a common origin or decent (Idang, 2015, p 98).
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a system of reinforcing what is already in a person."
Thought is a system of reinforcing what is already in a person.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a very aspect of the human existence and it helps man psychologically, spiritually, socially and economically."
Religion is a very aspect of the human existence and it helps man psychologically, spiritually, socially and economically.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is responsible for cultivating the whole person of the African (ibid, p198)."
The traditional African religion is responsible for cultivating the whole person of the African (ibid, p198).

Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a reminder to our western counterparts that no culture is ironclad; every culture has something to benefit and gain from other surrounding cultures around."
Contemporary African thought is a reminder to our western counterparts that no culture is ironclad; every culture has something to benefit and gain from other surrounding cultures around.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ are the only things capable of transforming our economic and spiritual lives."
Hard work and good behavior are the only things capable of transforming our economic and spiritual lives.

Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a point of separation between the living and the dead, but it nevertheless becomes a point of convergence when it becomes a shrine of an ancestor."
The grave is a point of separation between the living and the dead, but it nevertheless becomes a point of convergence when it becomes a shrine of an ancestor.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a part and parcel of the African worldview."
The African traditional religion is a part and parcel of the African worldview.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a protective force for man, hence, when it's natural order is disturbed, man loses that privilege of protection and shelter."
The universe is a protective force for man, hence, when it's natural order is disturbed, man loses that privilege of protection and shelter.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a relative thing and setting universal standards for anything is a mistaken idea."
Truth is a relative thing and setting universal standards for anything is a mistaken idea.

Complete the statement from the course material: "______ are the living-dead who once co-existed with the rest of us, but later died a natural death at old age in order to keep watch over the community form the land of the living-dead."
The ancestors are the living-dead who once co-existed with the rest of us, but later died a natural death at old age in order to keep watch over the community form the land of the living-dead.

Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the defining quality of man, so when it is said to be lacking in a people, those people have been subtly reduced to a level lower than human."
Rationality is the defining quality of man, so when it is said to be lacking in a people, those people have been subtly reduced to a level lower than human.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a provident creator who is directing each individual and the unverse to a definite end (Ikenga- Metuh 1987)."
God is a provident creator who is directing each individual and the unverse to a definite end (Ikenga- Metuh 1987).

Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is an established system of rules and ways of thinking, to the effect that individual thinking within the said society, usually align with the already established system of thought."
A thought system is an established system of rules and ways of thinking, to the effect that individual thinking within the said society, usually align with the already established system of thought.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a theory of black racial self- consciousness as well as the ethno-philosophical endowment of the black race."
Negritude is a theory of black racial self- consciousness as well as the ethno-philosophical endowment of the black race.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the very foundation of African metaphysics, and it is the basis of all the mythical and mystical activities in African religion."
Magic is the very foundation of African metaphysics, and it is the basis of all the mythical and mystical activities in African religion.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the hallmark of the African universe because the world itself is created by a Being who is in charge of it by established laws and values."
Orderliness is the hallmark of the African universe because the world itself is created by a Being who is in charge of it by established laws and values.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is concerned with the values and life practices indigenous to Africa and which distinguish them from Europeans."
African humanism is concerned with the values and life practices indigenous to Africa and which distinguish them from Europeans.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a universal phenomenon; it is present in all civilizations."
Humanism is a universal phenomenon; it is present in all civilizations.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the sum total of the way of life of the African, including his religion, arts, mores, sayings, and so on."
African philosophy is the sum total of the way of life of the African, including his religion, arts, mores, sayings, and so on.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a reflection of what is available in our vocabulary, word structure, and semantics which determine our thought pattern."
Language is a reflection of what is available in our vocabulary, word structure, and semantics which determine our thought pattern.

Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is concerned with beliefs such as God, spirits, human life, magic, the hereafter, and so on.  Practices, ceremonies and festivals, these are also very important in any religion."
African religion is concerned with beliefs such as God, spirits, human life, magic, the hereafter, and so on.  Practices, ceremonies and festivals, these are also very important in any religion.
